high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "mansionstyles." The post features an aerial view of a luxurious property located in New Rochelle, New York. The property is situated on a waterfront, with a large body of water surrounding it on three sides. Setting: The property is surrounded by lush greenery, including well-maintained lawns and trees. There is a prominent arched stone bridge leading to the main house, which spans over a smaller body of water. The main house is a large, white building with a red-tiled roof
